svg.title: Sentinel product architecture
svg.desc: A layered architecture diagram showing Sentinel's observation pipeline, durable incident runtime, AI evidence reasoning, governed remediation, verification, memory, operator experience, and platform foundations.
svg.text: Evidence-driven incident intelligence • governed recovery • measurable outcomes

g.text: Tenant-scoped configuration enriches the runtime; it never bypasses policy or execution boundaries.
Canonical event pipeline and durable incident ownership
Event time, deduplication, correlation, and workflow state convert noisy signals into a coherent incident.
Evidence blackboard with adversarial, inspectable reasoning
Models use typed tools and structured contracts; evidence remains authoritative, attributable, and challengeable.
No agent holds production credentials. The broker executes only constrained, approved capabilities and verifies the outcome.
Partitions • fencing • logical time • CRDT-safe shared state
Five production-shaped services • one vertical incident path before service breadth
